notes: SITE: NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced (Williams-Sonoma UK) with Searchspring (siteId mrb1uc) rendering all facet-browse grids client-side via bgfilter.ss_hierarchy; captured via Playwright network interception of the mrb1uc.a.searchspring.io/api/search/category.json XHR (tier 2; the endpoint is itself a plain JSON API, reachable by curl too, but tier 1 alone could not discover the exact bgfilter value the client sends). No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow found. NAVIGATION CHECKED: main mega-nav 'New' menu (which lists 'Shop New Arrivals' plus 12 category quick-links), footer, and the homepage promo banner ('Hundreds of new arrivals just dropped! Shop the autumn collection'). FOUND a genuine site-defined New Arrivals hierarchy: /new/new-arrivals (ss_hierarchy='New>Shop New Arrivals', H1 'Shop New Arrivals') as parent, with 13 nav-linked children, each its own canonical URL and distinct ss_hierarchy leaf under 'New>Shop New Arrivals>...'. Of those 13: 'New Sofas & Armchairs' (/new/new-arrivals/new-sofas-armchairs) self-declares <link rel=canonical> back to /new/new-arrivals/new-furniture and returns byte-identical title/content to that page - confirmed true alias/duplicate of New Furniture, so it was dropped and NOT recorded as a separate row (New Furniture is already recorded). 'New Curtains' (/new/new-arrivals/new-curtains) returned pagination.totalResults=0 (genuinely empty) - dropped per the zero-product rule. The remaining 11 children (Furniture/Rugs/Lighting/Bed Linen/Cushions & Throws/Christmas/Decor/Kitchen & Dining/Art & Mirrors/Bath, plus the All New Arrivals parent) are recorded below, all confirmed to be real product grids (facet-browse template, not editorial) via their own Searchspring XHR with real pagination. QTY: every category.json response on this site's facet-browse template injects exactly 2 non-product marketing banners into merchandising.content.inline (verified data-banner-type='image', e.g. an Autumn Sale promo banner and a PayPal banner), counted inside pagination.totalResults; the -2 offset was directly proven on the single-page New Furniture listing (totalResults=68, actual results array=66 real product entries, exact match) and confirmed to be a one-time injection, not per-page (page 2 of the multi-page All New Arrivals listing carried 0 banners and a full 72 real results), so qty = totalResults - 2 throughout. Sum of the 11 children (389) exceeds the All New Arrivals parent total (362) - expected overlap (the same new product can be tagged into more than one New-Arrivals sub-bucket, e.g. a new decor item also appearing under New Kitchen & Dining), not an error, consistent with the brief's overlap allowance. No 'New Collection'-style ambiguous editorial page was found in this nav path - every /new/new-arrivals/* URL checked rendered a real Searchspring facet-browse grid with a genuine product count, not a lookbook/campaign page.
